source.title: Community Office Hours March 2025
source.description: In the March 2025 Community Office Hours, Heather and Monica chat with Software Engineer Vineet Deo about the new Account Hub for the desktop app, coming to the Beta release at the end of April. This feature will streamline and improve the account setup, especially for users new to Thunderbird! If you want to know more about this feature, how we've developed it, and how it was a true cross-team effort, be sure to watch! 00:00 Introduction 01:34 Account Hub overview 02:33 Key issues and solutions 04:05 User flow and design 05:49 Account Hub features 07:09 Account Hub team 09:50 Account Hub demo 12:52 Dark mode and design 13:56 What prompted account hub? 16:29 What if it crashes during setup? 17:49 Planned timeline 20:42 Working with the design team 24:27 Improved performance? 27:46 What features still need adding? 30:00 What were your major challenges? 38:53 Closing
